verdict.rationale: Sierra's Explorer sends an automatic weekly briefing on key trends and emerging issues, and lets leaders query thousands of real conversations in natural language. Insights reports let users click any data point to investigate what is driving a trend. This covers the core of proactively surfacing emerging issues, though all of it is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: explicit topic clustering or categorization of conversations, evidence of real-time or early-warning alerting ahead of volume spikes (the briefing is weekly), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
